description: This file defines the Paths class within the SuiteCRM utility namespace, providing methods to retrieve various directory paths used throughout the application, such as library, custom library, container file, and project paths.

classes.name: Paths
classes.description: A utility class for managing and retrieving standard directory paths in the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: getContainersFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the 'containers.php' file within the API core directory.

methods.name: getLibraryPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the library directory.

methods.name: getCustomLibraryPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the custom library directory, which is a 'custom' subdirectory within the project path.

methods.name: getProjectPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the project root directory.
